acceptance: Deferred to the author (DECISIONS: nuclear and run-of-river hydro reference values are compiled by Claude from public statistics; the calibration is not accepted until the author has reviewed them). Acceptance targets of plan 4.5 S8: nuclear within +-10 % of Energy Trends 5.1 (supplied basis), hydro within +-15 % of DUKES.
applies_to: value-corrected profile only (correction p05.firm-availability; findings P5-09, P5-10, P6-10). The doctoral profile keeps the 35aadb3 constant availability 1.0.
calendar: fixed 365-day year of 48 half-hour periods per day starting 1 January 00:00 UTC; periods beyond 17520 wrap

nuclear.basis: Station load factor = PRIS 2019-2024 mean of station supplied energy / (PRIS reference power x hours) [D], applied as a constant derate of every period (no outage calendar in P0; planned-outage calendars are a P1 item). The model capacity is the EDF station capacity of value_uk_nuclear_policy_v1.json, so the energy-preserving model load factor is pris_load_factor x pris_reference_mw / model capacity.
nuclear.retirement: In the year of announced_generation_end 'YYYY-MM' (value_uk_nuclear_policy_v1.json), availability is zero from the first period of the following month (2030-03 -> period 4320).

AGR.grade: [D] 2019-2024 mean of the four operating AGR stations

PWR.grade: [D] Sizewell B 2019-2024 mean; used for planned PWR/EPR projects (Hinkley Point C, Sizewell C)

national_aggregate.grade: [V2]/[E] DESNZ nuclear load factor 2023 72.4 %, 2024 72.3 % (N13, N15); used for an undifferentiated 'Nuclear' asset

hydro_natural_flow.basis: Annual load factor x monthly shape (mean 1 over the 12 months) applied to the dispatch capacity of run-of-river hydro.
hydro_natural_flow.load_factor_grade: [V2] 2023 only (Statista H4, citing DESNZ); DUKES 6.3 2019-2024 values are [NV] - the author must read DUKES 6.3 (xlsx) and decide mean or yearly values
hydro_natural_flow.monthly_shape_grade: [NV] flat placeholder: no monthly or quarterly hydro statistic was readable (Energy Trends 6.1 is xlsx only)
hydro_natural_flow.capacity_note: DUKES implied capacity about 1.89 GW (5538 GWh / (0.334 x 8760 h)) [D]; the GBP1 fleet carries 2000 MW, so the modelled annual energy is about 5.85 TWh (+6 % against 5.5 TWh).

sources.N1: World Nuclear Association Reactor Database (IAEA PRIS operating details), accessed 2026-10-06
sources.N15: Secondary page citing DESNZ load factors [V2]
sources.H4: Statista, Load factor of electricity from hydropower in the UK 2010-2023 (2025-01-14) [V2]
